author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the controversy cycle from the media and politicians surrounding GTA 6. This is a cycle I remember since I was a kid watching the original Vice City being demonized on national TV. This time I expect things to be different and more mature. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar! This time we deep dive into Omarchy by DHH. Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
